**Argentina won the 2022 FIFA World Cup.**

In the final on December 18, 2022, Argentina drew 3–3 with France after regulation and extra time (famously featuring Kylian Mbappé's hat-trick and Lionel Messi's two goals), with Argentina prevailing in the penalty shootout — recorded in the data as the match winner.

Along the way, Argentina beat the Netherlands in the quarter-final (2–2, won on penalties) and Croatia 3–0 in the semi-final, while France beat England (2–1) and Morocco (2–0) to reach the final.
